section-b-b-question-set-1-q13.zh: 注意：2020 年《陆路交通法令》修订后，法定上限已降为每 100 毫升血液 50 毫克（呼气 22 微克 / 100 毫升，尿液 67 毫克 / 100 毫升）。本题按 KPP 题库原答案作答，现实中请以新标准为准，酒后不开车。
section-b-b-question-set-1-q13.en: Note: since the 2020 amendment to the Road Transport Act, the legal limit is 50 mg per 100 ml of blood (22 µg/100 ml breath, 67 mg/100 ml urine). This answer follows the KPP question bank; on the road, the new limits apply. Don’t drink and drive.
section-b-b-question-set-1-q13.ms: Nota: sejak pindaan Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 2020, had sah ialah 50 mg setiap 100 ml darah (nafas 22 µg/100 ml, air kencing 67 mg/100 ml). Jawapan ini mengikut bank soalan KPP; di jalan raya, had baharu terpakai. Jangan memandu selepas minum.
